analytic_solver_check.test: Analytic periodic Taylor-Green vortex, diffusive refinement, D3Q19 MRT
analytic_solver_check.acceptance: Each velocity error < 0.02; fine error less than half coarse; periodic mass error < 1e-10.

scenarios.sampling_comparison: Mean vector fields over 8–12 s versus 12–16 s
Mean vector fields over 8–12 s versus 12–16 s

comparison_note: Both resolutions use the same 0.75 m slice and 8–16 s averaging window. Passage masks are sampled on each grid; these are sensitivity checks, not a rigorous grid-convergence or experimental validation study.
summary: The displayed fields are fixed in time. Taylor–Green solver check passed (1.96% → 0.49% relative velocity error). The 128-cell Scenario 2 run failed its numerical stability gate and was rejected. Both displayed fields use the completed 64-cell computations. Their passage speeds change by up to 3.2% between averaging blocks, but this does not establish accuracy. This is a provisional scenario preview, not a validated wind model. Scenario 1 also shows up to 138% passage-speed change with refinement, so its numerical accuracy is unresolved.

refinement_failure.reason: Numerical stability gate failed before the requested 16-second run completed.
refinement_failure.display_policy: Keep both scenario displays at the completed 64-cell resolution and explicitly label the preview unvalidated. Do not claim grid convergence or silently modify molecular viscosity, geometry, or wind conditions.
refinement_failure.root_cause: Not yet established. The failure rejects the refined result; stability of the coarse run does not prove its accuracy.
